list: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned; all offline single-player
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and names its sources; where a requirement is still unconfirmed this close to launch (19 Nov 2026) the guide says so instead of inventing it.

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list
GTABase — GTA 6 trophy list and guides
CryptoGames.gg — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements: Full List
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list
GTA-Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements

roadmap.title: Play the story — and catch the one missable moment
roadmap.text: Finish all 5 chapters (Gone Fishing first, Operation Savage Glory last). Do the Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia at Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth — it is the only thing in the game reported as potentially missable. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go, and take optional missions when they appear; progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even though you cannot see it until after the story. Keep cheats off: they disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion checklist + 70 of 80 challenges
roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The checklist is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, any 100 optional missions, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal gang operations, 15 of 18 meditations, and any 70 of the 80 challenges. Most trophies in this guide pop naturally while you work through it.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 counted stranger strands, the named questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), any remaining collectibles, races, drone races and shooting-range golds, then mop up the odd one-out trophies (UFO, Ten Pin, Personal Best). The platinum pops when the last of the other 54 is earned.

missable_audit: Only ONE trophy is reported as potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude, because its first meditation (Chapter 1, Jason's house balcony with Lucia) can only be done in Chapter 1 — and even there it is still unconfirmed whether that meditation is actually required. Every story trophy is unmissable: there is no mission replay, but free-roam continues after the story and every trophy-related quest giver returns, so nothing story-related locks you out. Optional missions that expire do not affect any trophy. Source: PowerPyx roadmap and Step 1; GTABase and PowerPyx agree on the single missable flag.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task, no multiplayer and no DLC requirement — it is single-player only. Work the roadmap in order (story, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup) and this is the last trophy you will hear. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; Exophase / PSNProfiles list.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks on the last one.
No online play is needed: all 55 trophies are offline, single-player.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. You cannot miss it — just play the opening mission through to its end. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Play Chapter 1's opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.
It is the first mission of the game, so it pops within the opening hour.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Play the chapter's main missions in order; it pops when the chapter closes (PowerPyx notes it unlocks as Chapter 2's first mission begins). While you are still in Chapter 1, do the Lucia balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — the one thing that may not wait. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Complete every main mission of Chapter 1.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the morning balcony meditation with Lucia.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Keep playing the main missions; it pops as Chapter 3 opens. Chapter 2 is also where you first switch freely between Jason and Lucia (after Coffee Break) and where the Scooter Bros app and garage purchases unlock — start scanning vehicles for later. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Complete every main mission of Chapter 2.
After Coffee Break, start scanning new vehicles with the WAiNK app.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It pops once the first missions of Chapter 4 are underway. Chapter 3 opens several trophy threads at once — Andy's questline, Randy's wish list, Tyrone's labs, Yasmani's jewelry jobs and the Key Cloner — so take the optional missions as they appear. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Complete every main mission of Chapter 3.
Take Andy's, Randy's and Tyrone's optional questlines as they are marked.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It pops after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. The bank-vault robbery thread (That's Where The Money Is…) also opens in Chapter 4 — finish it, since it unlocks Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Complete every main mission of Chapter 4, ending with Starting From Zero.
Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to open bank-vault robberies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold, automatic: finish the final mission of the game (the last mission of Chapter 5, after Starting From Zero). Once the credits roll you return to free-roam, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats, and every remaining trophy can still be earned. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Complete the final mission of Chapter 5.
After the credits, check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion for stage 2.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable — it is a required mission on the road through Chapter 2. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; official description.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to the end.
Chapter 2 missions run in story order; keep following the pink main-mission markers.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. A required mission, so it cannot be missed — just follow the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; official description.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist to the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Required story mission, unmissable. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; official description.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play to the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Required story mission, unmissable. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; official description.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Required story mission, unmissable — and a useful preview of the airport, which matters for Catch Me If You Can later. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; official description.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Required story mission, unmissable. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; official description.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory to the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold and the hardest trophy in the set. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The list is forgiving — about 60% of true completion, per PowerPyx: scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, do 300 stunts, complete any 100 optional missions, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal gang operations, 15 of 18 meditations, all 15 Target Decks, and any 70 of 80 challenges. Most side quests are NOT required. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable — it is all doable in post-story free-roam. Budget roughly 100 hours for this stage on top of the 60-80 hour story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide and 100% checklist guide.

steps.text: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app.
Study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars.
Complete 300 stunts, 100 optional missions, 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations and 70 of 80 challenges.

sources: GTABase — GTA 6 trophy list and guides

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver: complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida (the 100% checklist needs 300). There are four kinds: 130 Stunt Jumps over ramps, 202 Under the Bridges flights, 40 Knife Flights between buildings and 25 Base Jumps. Mix freely — Under the Bridges are the quickest, per PowerPyx. Track them at Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each completed stunt stays marked with its own name. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Do any 250 of 397 stunts across the four categories.
Start with Under the Bridges — the fastest category.
Track progress at Progress > Activities > Stunts or Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities (Touchpad > Progress) — scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. You will meet most of them through the story and the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Do one of each of the 9 activity types (fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video game, a race win, a stunt).
Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types remain.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver: earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting-range locations. The golds are not too difficult, per PowerPyx, and the same ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger. Work through the ranges after the story with a weapon you are comfortable with, and use the range's own scoring feedback to learn each challenge's par. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (12 locations, 42 gold medals).

steps.text: Visit all 12 Shooting Range locations.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). You only need one win per location, not all 42 races. Drone racing also counts toward the race activity type for Master of None. Learn each course's racing line with a practice run, then push for the win. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (14 locations, 42 races).

steps.text: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
42 drone races exist in total, but only one win per location is needed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Each location counts once, so you need wins at 20 separate spots — repeating the same race does not help. Use a fast, well-handling car, learn the corners, and take the easiest locations first. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (40 unique race locations).

steps.text: Win races at 20 different locations out of the 40 unique ones.
Repeating a race you already won does not add to the count — move to a new location.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you about a fishing spot west of Key Lento — it appears as a purple map icon. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1's Feng Shui mission to meet Cal.
Answer Cal's text and go to the fishing spot west of Key Lento.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home with the controllers from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of a game — finish all its levels at least once — but you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you enjoy most. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Play Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind at home, or Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine.
Finish all levels to reach the end of the game once.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3, playing as Lucia, you get a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All quests stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, answer Andy's call and follow her address to Belville.
Complete all 5 Andy quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving questline starts in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton): he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons for shipwrecks — dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Clear 7 shipwrecks in total across his sets; after each set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story but returns (as Jason, calling Brian in Chapter 2 speeds it up), so this is not missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, follow Kenton's KR marker in Key Lento.
Dive the marked shipwrecks, dig up treasures with the metal detector and return them.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his quest sets.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies (check out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all 5 Billy quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver: finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — many optional questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) do NOT count as strangers for this trophy. Confirmed counters, per PowerPyx: Kirk (Skunk Ape — Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and his deliveries). All strangers are still findable in post-story free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count. More strangers are still being discovered, so check the source guide if you are stuck on the last few. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Complete stranger strands that count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed.
Do not rely on Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy or Billy — they do not count.
Watch the count in the trophy list; all strangers remain after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List unlocks in Chapter 3 during the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, when you steal the Granforma Zorrusso for him with the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D and more). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on his list, steal it and drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) — good condition pays more. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street, often around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach hotels. Still doable after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: In Chapter 3, steal the Zorrusso for Randy in Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Scan sports cars with the WAiNK app to find the 16 on his wish list.
Deliver each car to Randy's garage (RK icon, west Vice City).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter; once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), which pops the trophy. Still available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, find the Synthetic Lab markers in Vice City.
Destroy labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then complete Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE only potentially missable trophy — read this first. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate as both Jason and Lucia at each spot (each spot counts +2 if done with both). Track them at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The risk: one meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house and becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. Do that. Honest caveat from PowerPyx: that Chapter 1 meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is actually required for the trophy — the safe play is to do it anyway. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide and meditation locations guide.

steps.text: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and accept the balcony meditation.
Meditate at all 18 spots across the 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia.
Track progress at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

sources: GTABase — GTA 6 trophy list and guides

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason (Lucia cannot receive it) and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do it, and he marks hunting spots with purple icons. His quests ask you to hunt specific animals and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation; one clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally. Honest caveat: PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal unlocks the trophy. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, answer Bret Vogel's text as Jason and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals he marks and bring them to him.
Use the Killtelligence SM-69 from an Ammu-Nation weapon locker for clean kills.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver: complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 card-set locations in total, so you only need 3 of them — pick the sets whose cards are closest together and easiest to reach. Cards are found in the open world; use the guide's set locations rather than wandering. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (18 collectible card set locations).

steps.text: Find and complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets.
Use the card-set location guide to pick the 3 closest sets instead of searching blindly.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver: scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app — hold Up then R1 while looking at a scannable object. Any 100 count, and there are well over 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are named by PowerPyx, plus more. Scan everything you pass while doing other trophies and this pops on its own. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Hold Up + R1 to WAiNK-scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures.
Scan any 100 locations (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures named).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there). There are 8 groups of 10 challenges; view them at Progress > Challenges, where a checkmark shows each completed one. Many complete naturally while you work on other trophies — leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining ones. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GTA Spotter (80 challenges in 8 groups of 10).

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
Track them at Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest ones left.

sources: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (cause carnage until the stars hit 4), then escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works well, and if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it leaves. Easiest route, per PowerPyx: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank-vault robberies give 4 stars. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner (Right + Triangle) so you are together.
Raise a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel is the easiest route.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break (partner free-roam), with your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — keep the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing (Ammu-Nation). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a few items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and move on. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, bring your partner and stay wanted throughout.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back — the 3 north Vice City jewelry stores work well.
If it does not pop after the 3rd shop, rob a 4th; the pop is delayed ~30 seconds.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of the 557 in the game (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Use the WAiNK app — hold Up to open it instantly — and scan vehicles as they pass; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that goes by. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist anyway, so this pops early. Check totals at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan passing vehicles with R1.
Discover 100 unique vehicles; scanning counts, driving is not needed.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must down 5 enemies in one use — it only lasts a few seconds, so prepare first. Raise your Focus level (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots all help; level 4 is best), eat or drink to buff focus, take Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and fire without missing. Per PowerPyx it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang enemies. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Raise Focus toward level 4 (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots).
Buff focus, take Adrenaline, wear armor, and line up 5 gang enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and down all 5 in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, go to the boarding bridge, use the stairs and door beside it to get inside, go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is delayed until you are far enough away. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Go to VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Board it, enter the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino). Find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Enter a tank in the south of the base and fire at enemies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry-store robberies with green icons. Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun (the prompt offers kicking the door, which triggers the alarm, or the Snap Gun for the stealth route). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun, not by kicking it.
Use the safe code from the back-room note, destroy the footage and disable the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver: rob any 5 bank vaults and escape (all 8 are needed for the 100% checklist). First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): you tail a security van to a bank, a guard carries a briefcase in and the vault opens — go in while it is open and rob it, bringing your partner and handing off a bag with Right. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip for security-van locations (after his earlier Payday Loans quests); follow a van to its bank and rob the vault. Each robbery gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Up to $205,000 per bank. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Finish That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 to open bank-vault robberies.
Buy Yasmani's security-van tips ($10,000 each), tail a van to a bank and rob the open vault.
Escape the 4-star wanted level; repeat for 5 vaults (8 for 100%).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault in That's Where The Money Is… (the same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults) counts as robbing an armored truck, so this pops automatically there. Earlier method: find an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Do That's Where The Money Is… — the vault robbery counts as an armored-truck robbery.
Or block an armored truck, sticky-bomb its back door and loot it.
Escape the red heat radius before it pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog on the map until the entire map is visible. Do it after the story when you have a plane and the time to sweep the map in passes. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Take a plane and fly over every fogged area until the map is fully revealed.
Sweep the map in passes after the story, when a plane is easy to get.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total and all 39 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count at Progress > Gangs. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Follow the yellow map icons; track counts at Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy — a quiet moment after the chaos. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it beside the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first (unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS): hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and keep driving — the pop is slightly delayed and only triggers from this specific blue Banshee, not any other car. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom.
Drive it straight through the showroom window and keep going.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the illegal gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — blow the safe with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation. You first go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing enemies is not needed. Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for what is left. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling).
Take the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, and blow the safe with sticky bombs.
Escape the police; the trophy pops after the escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon). Only possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a gym membership and always train together: call your partner (Right + Triangle) so that while one character works out, the other completes their training too, doubling progress. Filter the map for fitness clubs (Activities dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, work out with both characters together (call your partner first).
Raise both characters' Strength to maximum (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the trophy list itself tracks your count out of 500. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence and clean escapes push the Professional side; incapacitating enemies is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing, cop killing or driving over gravestones is Psycho; and excessive violence can lock in the permanent Irredeemable status, which makes cops more aggressive — avoid that. It happens passively across the other trophies; if you are short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications.
Do 500 profile-affecting actions (robberies, objectives, escapes); the trophy list tracks the count.
Avoid the permanent Irredeemable status from excessive violence.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — do not trust any walkthrough that states this one as fact yet. As of 20 Nov 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner (the store is in Little Cuba, Vice City). No source I checked has pinned down the exact trigger. Try revisiting the Payday Loans store after the story and robbing it again, and check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates — this entry will be wrong if it invents a method. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (marked unknown there).

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: believed to involve the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba — no verified trigger yet.
Revisit the store after the story and try robbing it again; watch the PowerPyx guide for updates.

sources: CryptoGames.gg — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements: Full List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Go solo, after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Find the blinking car at the roadside (drive away and return if it is absent).
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the dropped woman back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded — Vice City streets or Ocean Beach — and keep moving so you can reach the next pedestrian quickly. Ten kicks inside the minute pops it. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Ride a bike through a crowded area (Vice City or Ocean Beach).
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery. It comes naturally from the robbery work for the 100% checklist; a single bank vault can give up to $205,000. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most).
Reach $250,000 laundered in total across all deliveries.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — it is cumulative, not one purchase. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos, the most expensive items. The game has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Buy the big-ticket items and this pops during normal play. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops.
Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos (the priciest items).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story-related garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone, and you buy garages through that app. A quick way to earn the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2's Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app ($160,000 total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2's Moses mission to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) for parking spots.
Drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and Respray + Register each.
